description:
[Universal CPV code classifier & Modulo 11 check-digit validator. Pure statutory calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Validates and classifies public procurement supplies, works, and services against Regulation (EC) No 213/2008 CPV 8+1 digit codes with Modulo 11 check-digit verification.
Usage: Use this tool to validate CPV codes in tender documents or resolve division, group, and category hierarchies.
Returns: JSON object with { queriedCodeOrKeyword: string, isValidCpvFormat: boolean, isCheckDigitValid: boolean, cleanCpvCode: string, hierarchy: object, descriptions: object }.

cpvCodeOrKeyword.description: 8-digit or 9-digit CPV code (e.g. 72220000-1 or 72220000) or sector keyword

supplementaryCode.description: Optional alphanumeric supplementary CPV code (e.g. AA01-1)

name: cpv_code_classifier_validator
